about: lev_3_m1 ticker bomb locked to a walking goliath (PlayerTickerBomb_AttachToParent 0x0044e120): Roman warped into volume 231 (sends 1600: the three goliath squads set off south at ~9 units/s, patrol_speed 10 by marker_strict_patrol), then at frame 900 onto goliath 170 (squad 170, tag 2001), ~110 units from where its site 173 was placed; the squads see him and halt; Use held from 905: the bomb (riding the goliath's ref_ticker bone) arms after arm_time 2 s, its 6 s fuse blows it, send_trigger_explode 2001 kills the goliath (the squad's receive_trigger_kill) and its death sends 3000 (counter 7). Without the lock the site stays at the placement and nothing arms (the remaster before 2026-10-16: trigger 2001 only in the original). The original's Object_Attach call (hook trace_calls, original.log) has the goliath (no instance id) as the parent, not squad #170. Roman's health is held in both games (hold_health, [test] play_hold_health): the remaster's Roman, pushed out of the goliath's legs (G1), was shot dead at frame 1072..1122 as the fight's rolls fell, and its failure pause (22.9 s) beat the fuse (23.12 s) after the 2026-10-17 weapons merge; the scenario is about the lock, not the fight

known.events.sounds: B17 rest (level ambience: imp_boulder_roll_lp and the like at other frames), and the fight's sounds of B6 / G1 below
known.grunt.pos: B24: captain_sniper 228 slides off the beam of v_rockettower2 272 (lev_3_m1_start); later the squads' members move on other paths as the fight differs (G1)
known.vehicle.pos: G2: squads 171 / 172 head for their first marker on another line (the original's goliath 172 is ~12 units further south by frame 210, ~2 by 900: which marker of spline 600 a squad starts at, 0x0042d1b0 / state 0x96, is not traced); goliath 170 walks within 8 units of the original's
known.roman.pos: the warp's landing: the original's Roman drifts ~3 units (1.5, 2.9) while it falls the last ~7 units onto the ground between goliath 170's legs and lands ~0.4 s later; the remaster's lands straight under the warp point. Since G1 (2026-10-18, goliath.rs hulls in physics.rs HIT_ONLY) neither is pushed: both stand still there until the blast (remaster within 0.1 units from 924 to 1380)
known.grunt.mind: B6: the original's far grunts (captain_sniper 228 among them) take Roman 16 frames after he appears beside the squads
known.roman.health: held (hold_health); G1 fixed 2026-10-18: the goliath's hulls are hit-only bodies and an enemy bullet stops at the first body it meets (player.rs projectiles), so the legs shield him as in the original
